interface.longDescription: Read Chinese dishes, Japanese chef recipes, desserts and kitchen references directly from public GitHub Markdown files. Follow one selected preparation with its original quantities, explanations and source links, or build a shopping checklist. Requires a host that can read public HTTPS text. No terminal, Python, Panfolio account, API key or app installation is required. Does not access personal app notes or favorites.
defaultPrompt: Use Panfolio to guide me through asparagus pork rolls.

Create a shopping checklist for my selected Panfolio dishes.
